summary: Starter notebook with a simple linear baseline and minimal preprocessing.
Shared finance ratios, semantic missingness flags, and controlled polynomial features.
Added the first small MPS branch on top of the polynomial tree family.
XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, ExtraTrees, and an MPS lane combined through a meta model.
Out-of-fold target statistics and bagging pushed the local score above the public lane.
A compact neural lane improved the final combiner on local validation.
The strongest local blend used a small weighted mix of the best late-stage branches.
